name: Shikkoku ni Nureru Seijaku ~Jisatsu Shigansha~
original_name: 漆黒に濡れる静寂 ～自殺志願者～
source:
No one knows the pain of the other people. Such decaying souls gather in the virtual space. One day main character reads a post on the forum "I hope to find a person to die together". Protagonist decides to come in contact with such girls and try to use or heal them, depending on situation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
沒有人知道他人的痛苦。腐朽的靈魂聚集在虛擬空間中。某天，主角在論壇上讀到一篇貼文：「希望找到一個願意一起死的人。」

他決定與這樣的女孩接觸，並根據情況利用她們，或是治癒她們。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]］
